errors.message: A parameter is invalid
errors.message_zh: 参数不合法
errors.meaning: A parameter is missing, has the wrong type or value, or the method is wrong. problems lists each one; param names the first.
errors.meaning_zh: 参数缺失、类型或取值不对，或者请求方法不对。problems 列出每一处问题，param 是第一个出错的参数。
errors.fix: Fix what problems says, then send the request again.
errors.fix_zh: 按 problems 改好再发。

errors.message: This call could cost more than the price cap allows
errors.message_zh: 这次调用可能超过你设的价格上限
errors.meaning: The most this call could cost (required) is above X-Max-Price (or max_price), so it did not run.
errors.meaning_zh: 这次调用最多可能花的钱（required）超过了 X-Max-Price（或 max_price），所以没有执行。
errors.fix: Raise the cap to at least required, ask for fewer items, or leave the cap out.
errors.fix_zh: 把上限调到 required 以上、少要一些条目，或者不设上限。

errors.message: The cursor does not exist
errors.message_zh: 这个 cursor 不存在
errors.meaning: The cursor is not one this API issued, or it was issued to another account.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个 cursor 不是我们发出的，或者是发给别的账户的。
errors.fix: Send page.next_cursor exactly as it came, or start the listing again without a cursor.
errors.fix_zh: 把 page.next_cursor 原样传回，或者不带 cursor 从头开始。

errors.message: The cursor belongs to another request
errors.message_zh: 这个 cursor 属于另一个请求
errors.meaning: The cursor was sent to another endpoint, or with other parameters than the page it came from (view and fields may change).
errors.meaning_zh: cursor 发到了别的接口，或者参数和它所在那一页不一样（view 和 fields 可以变）。
errors.fix: Resend with the endpoint and parameters of the page it came from.
errors.fix_zh: 用它所在那一页的接口和参数重新发。

errors.message: No credential was sent, or it is invalid, disabled or expired
errors.message_zh: 没有带凭证，或凭证无效、已停用、已过期
errors.meaning: The key is missing, malformed, revoked, disabled or expired (reason says which when known).
errors.meaning_zh: Key 缺失、格式不对、已撤销、已停用或已过期（知道原因时 reason 会写明）。
errors.fix: Send Authorization: Bearer <key> with a live key; next_step says where to get one.
errors.fix_zh: 带上 Authorization: Bearer <key>，用有效的 key；next_step 写了去哪里拿。

errors.message: The balance is too low
errors.message_zh: 余额不足
errors.meaning: The balance (available) cannot cover the most this call could cost (required).
errors.meaning_zh: 余额（available）不够这次调用的最高费用（required）。
errors.fix: Top up at top_up_url, then send the same request again, unchanged.
errors.fix_zh: 到 top_up_url 充值，到账后把同一个请求原样再发一次。

errors.message: This key has reached its spending limit
errors.message_zh: 这个 Key 已到花费上限
errors.meaning: This call would take the key past its daily, monthly or total spending limit (reason says which).
errors.meaning_zh: 这次调用会超出这个 key 的每日、每月或总额花费上限（reason 说明是哪个）。
errors.fix: Wait for the day or month to turn (UTC), raise the limit in the console, or use another key.
errors.fix_zh: 等到下一天或下个月（UTC），在控制台调高上限，或换一个 key。

errors.message: This account is suspended
errors.message_zh: 这个账号已停用
errors.meaning: The account this key belongs to is suspended, so none of its keys work.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个 key 所属的账号已停用，账号下的 key 都不能用。
errors.fix: Write to hello@okdata.online.
errors.fix_zh: 发邮件到 hello@okdata.online。

errors.message: This key may not call this endpoint
errors.message_zh: 这个 Key 不能调用这个接口
errors.meaning: This key may not call this endpoint (its scope leaves it out).
errors.meaning_zh: 这个 key 的可用范围里没有这个接口。
errors.fix: Use a key whose scope includes it, or widen the scope in the console.
errors.fix_zh: 换一个包含这个接口的 key，或在控制台放宽它的范围。

errors.message: There is no such endpoint
errors.message_zh: 没有这个接口
errors.meaning: No endpoint lives at that path. When the path is close to one that does, moved_to (or suggestion) names it.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个路径下没有接口。路径和某个接口很接近时，moved_to（或 suggestion）会给出正确的路径。
errors.fix: Use moved_to when given; otherwise check the id against the catalog (the path is the id with dots turned into slashes under /v1).
errors.fix_zh: 有 moved_to 就用它；否则对照目录检查 id（路径是 /v1 加上把点换成斜杠的 id）。

errors.message: The platform says this does not exist or is not public
errors.message_zh: 平台上没有这个内容，或不公开
errors.meaning: The post, account or page does not exist or is not public. Endpoints whose charge_when_not_found is above 0 charge this answer (the source billed us for it): the body then says charged: true and amount.
errors.meaning_zh: 内容、账号或页面不存在或不公开。charge_when_not_found 大于 0 的接口会对这个结果计费（数据源也向我们收了钱）：这时返回体里 charged 为 true，并给出 amount。
errors.fix: Final answer; retrying will not change it.
errors.fix_zh: 这是最终结果，重试也一样。

errors.message: There is no kept result for this request ID
errors.message_zh: 这个请求号没有保留的结果
errors.meaning: No kept result for this request ID on this account (it failed, or was never made).
errors.meaning_zh: 这个账号下没有这个请求号的结果（调用失败了，或从没发生）。
errors.fix: Check the request ID; only successful calls keep a result.
errors.fix_zh: 核对请求号；只有成功的调用会保留结果。

errors.message: This idempotency key was used for a different request
errors.message_zh: 这个幂等键已用于另一个请求
errors.meaning: This Idempotency-Key was used in the last 24 h for a different request.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个 Idempotency-Key 在 24 小时内已用于另一个请求。
errors.fix: Use a new key for a new request.
errors.fix_zh: 新请求用新的 key。

errors.message: A call with this idempotency key is still running
errors.message_zh: 带这个幂等键的调用还在进行
errors.meaning: A call with this Idempotency-Key is still running.
errors.meaning_zh: 带这个 Idempotency-Key 的调用还在进行。
errors.fix: Retry in a moment with the same key; you get its result, charged once.
errors.fix_zh: 稍后用同一个 key 重试，拿到它的结果，只扣一次费。

errors.message: The cursor has expired
errors.message_zh: 这个 cursor 已过期
errors.meaning: The cursor is older than the endpoint's cursor lifetime (page.cursor_expires_at said when).
errors.meaning_zh: cursor 超过了这个接口的有效期（page.cursor_expires_at 写了到期时间）。
errors.fix: Start the listing again without a cursor, and skip the ids you already have.
errors.fix_zh: 不带 cursor 从头开始，跳过已经拿到的 id。

errors.message: The result is older than 24 hours and was deleted
errors.message_zh: 结果已超过 24 小时，已删除
errors.meaning: The result is older than 24 hours and was deleted.
errors.meaning_zh: 结果已超过 24 小时，已删除。
errors.fix: Call the endpoint again (charged as usual).
errors.fix_zh: 重新调用接口（照常计费）。

errors.message: Too many requests, or too many calls in progress
errors.message_zh: 请求太多，或同时进行的调用太多
errors.meaning: The account sent too many requests this minute (reason: rate) or has too many calls running (reason: concurrency).
errors.meaning_zh: 账号这一分钟请求太多（reason: rate），或同时进行的调用太多（reason: concurrency）。
errors.fix: Wait retry_after_seconds (or for a running call to end), then send the same request.
errors.fix_zh: 等 retry_after_seconds 秒（或等进行中的调用结束），再发同一个请求。

errors.message: The account reached its daily spending allowance
errors.message_zh: 账号今天的花费已到每日上限
errors.meaning: The account reached its daily spending allowance.
errors.meaning_zh: 账号今天的花费已到每日上限。
errors.fix: Wait retry_after_seconds (the next UTC day), or write to us to raise it.
errors.fix_zh: 等 retry_after_seconds 秒（下一个 UTC 日），或联系我们调高。

errors.message: Too many uncharged calls today
errors.message_zh: 今天不扣费的调用太多了
errors.meaning: Too many uncharged calls (nothing found) today.
errors.meaning_zh: 今天没扣费的调用（查无结果）太多了。
errors.fix: Check the ids you send; it opens again at the next UTC day.
errors.fix_zh: 检查发送的 id；下一个 UTC 日恢复。

errors.message: The data came back, but whether it was charged is not known yet
errors.message_zh: 数据已返回，但还不知道是否扣费
errors.meaning: The data came back, but the charge could not be confirmed.
errors.meaning_zh: 数据已返回，但没能确认是否扣费。
errors.fix: Resend with the same Idempotency-Key to get the result without paying again, or look it up at /v1/calls/{request_id}.
errors.fix_zh: 带同一个 Idempotency-Key 重发，拿到结果且不会再扣费；或在 /v1/calls/{request_id} 查询。

errors.message: Something went wrong on our side; nothing was charged
errors.message_zh: 我们这边出错了，没有扣费
errors.meaning: Something went wrong on our side; nothing was charged.
errors.meaning_zh: 我们这边出错了，这次没有扣费。
errors.fix: Retry with backoff.
errors.fix_zh: 退避后重试。

errors.message: No result came back this time and nothing was charged; retry shortly
errors.message_zh: 这次没有取到结果，没有扣费，可以稍后重试
errors.meaning: Every data source for this endpoint failed on this request.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个接口的所有数据源这次都失败了。
errors.fix: Retry with backoff; check the status page if it persists.
errors.fix_zh: 退避后重试；持续失败就看状态页。

errors.message: The source of this cursor is not available right now
errors.message_zh: 这个 cursor 对应的数据源暂时不可用
errors.meaning: Only the source that served the previous page can continue it, and it is not available right now.
errors.meaning_zh: 只有返回上一页的数据源能接着翻，它现在不可用。
errors.fix: Retry later with the same cursor, or start the listing again without one.
errors.fix_zh: 稍后用同一个 cursor 重试，或者不带 cursor 从头开始。

errors.message: The data sources are busy; nothing was charged, retry shortly
errors.message_zh: 数据源繁忙，没有扣费，可以稍后重试
errors.meaning: Every data source for this endpoint is saturated.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个接口的所有数据源都在满负荷。
errors.fix: Retry with backoff.
errors.fix_zh: 退避后重试。

errors.message: This endpoint is paused
errors.message_zh: 这个接口已暂停
errors.meaning: This endpoint is paused right now; nothing ran.
errors.meaning_zh: 这个接口暂时停用了，这次没有执行。
errors.fix: Check /v1/catalog/status and retry once it is back.
errors.fix_zh: 看 /v1/catalog/status，恢复后再调用。

errors.message: The data did not arrive in time; nothing was charged
errors.message_zh: 数据没有及时返回，没有扣费
errors.meaning: The data did not come back in time. The hold was released, so nothing was charged.
errors.meaning_zh: 数据没有及时返回。预扣已退回，这次没有扣费。
errors.fix: Retry; an Idempotency-Key keeps a retry from ever being charged twice.
errors.fix_zh: 直接重试；带 Idempotency-Key 重试，永远不会重复扣费。

same_key.zh: 用同一个 Idempotency-Key 重试
